name: com.firstsymbol.vectra
description: Vector shapes for uGUI Canvas and world space: analytic SDF primitives, arbitrary paths, boolean operations, gradients, strokes with dashes, shadows, glows, bevels and other effects, SVG import and export. Burst-accelerated geometry and one batchable material for everything.

samples.description: Analytic primitives, path generators, paints, strokes, effects and boolean operations on one Canvas.
SVG documents rendered in Canvas and world space.
Every effect on one card each, soft, inverted and stencil masks, and a palette with a theme switch.
Boolean groups with moving operands, smooth-union metaballs and a BooleanShape built in code.
Fluent tweens, an AnimationClip driving Vectra Animated Properties, morphing and marching dashes.
VectraRenderer shapes in a 3D scene with generated colliders and click handling.
Frosted glass and advanced blend modes over moving UI (needs the Vectra Backdrop Feature on the URP renderer).
